evidence: Source review against native build 1: this change stops Panels' own idle /compact from sending Workers the mid-step memory-loss notice, and stops a second notice for one compaction. It adds an internal conversations column working_turn_compacted_through_sequence with a migration, threads one internal flag through conversation storage, adds an internal ConversationSystem read sender_message_ids_awaiting_outcome, and changes which boundary the Worker memory-notice scan reads. Routes, request and response payload shapes, event kinds, status codes, and the build floor are unchanged. A search of ios/ for working_turn, awaiting_outcome, memory_notice and compacted_through finds no use. Verification: focused conversation-system, Worker memory, readiness-loop, notice-transport and wiring tests passed; the full unit suite showed 5 failures and the integration suite 3, all of which also fail on clean staging or pass when run alone; ruff and mypy were clean. No signed-device, TestFlight, or native reconnect checks ran. The migration fills the new column for existing rows from their stored boundary, except where Panels' own /compact set it. It changes no route or payload.
